name: dc-guadalcanal-coop-rec
description: Desert Combat Guadalcanal co-op with the server-side recorder preloaded, bots only: the water level. OSA missile boats and the RHIB (lcvp), Fletcher, Enterprise, Sub7C and Gato, Daihatsu, plus Mi-24/AH-64/UH-60L, MiG-29/Su-25/F-16/A-10C, T-72/M1A1, BMP-2/M2A3, BRDM-2/Humvee and BM-21/MLRS/M-1974/M-109. DC's overlay of the vanilla level (vanilla's AI data). Needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client DesertCombat`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Let it play two rounds (each ends on tickets or at the 25-minute limit), then `lab.py stop`.
